d: On the evening of 25 November 2024, Vishvaraj Singh Mewar arrived at the gates of Udaipur's City Palace, hours after he had been crowned the new Maharana of Mewar at Chittorgarh Fort. One ritual was left: darshan of the sacred dhuni inside the palace. But the gates stayed shut. Inside were his own uncle, Arvind Singh Mewar, and his cousin Lakshyaraj Singh Mewar. By night, stones were flying, people were injured, and the administration had placed the disputed part of the palace under a receiver.
